description: This file defines the ProjectTask class, which represents tasks within a project management module of a CRM system. It includes properties for task details, methods for managing task hierarchies, calculating progress percentages, and interacting with the database.

classes.name: ProjectTask
classes.description: Represents a task within a project, providing methods for task management, hierarchy navigation, progress calculation, and database interaction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ProjectTask instance, setting default values and assigning the current user.

methods.name: skipParentUpdate
methods.description: Sets a flag to skip updating the parent task's progress percentage.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current task to the database and optionally updates associated statistics.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a short summary text for the task, typically its name.

methods.name: _get_depends_on_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a task that this task depends on.

methods.name: _get_project_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the associated project.

methods.name: _get_parent_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the parent project for this task.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a SQL WHERE clause for search queries based on a string.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface, such as ACL.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Determines access permissions for list view display, including security group checks.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query for exporting project task data.

methods.name: updateParentProjectTaskPercentage
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the progress percentage of a parent task based on its children.

methods.name: _calculateCompletePercent
methods.description: Helper method to compute percent complete based on subtasks.

methods.name: getProjectTaskParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent project task, if any.

methods.name: getNumberOfTasksInProject
methods.description: Gets the total number of tasks associated with a specific project.

methods.name: updateStatistic
methods.description: Updates the percent completion of tasks based on their child tasks and hierarchy.
